atomic_facts.fact: Adam Neumann is Israeli and American (Israeli-American).
Adam Neumann co-founded WeWork in 2010 (with Miguel McKelvey).
Adam Neumann was born on April 25, 1979.
Adam Neumann was not charged with fraud.
As of 2026-10-01, Adam Neumann has not been criminally convicted of fraud.
The New York State Attorney-General conducted an investigation in connection with Adam Neumann / WeWork's rise and fall.
No criminal charges were filed against Adam Neumann (as an outcome related to that investigation).
